element-710.title: Element 710
element-710.description: Element 710 is a strategically important resource used by Super Earth. Terminids can be processed into Element 710, making the species economically valuable to the Federation despite the enormous threat they pose.

democracy-space-station.title: Democracy Space Station (DSS)
democracy-space-station.description: The Democracy Space Station is a massive Super Earth battle station designed to support Helldiver operations across the Galactic War. Its blueprints were recovered from an abandoned First Galactic War weapons laboratory on X-45, and Helldivers later secured Gaellivare as its construction site. Once operational, the DSS became a Helldiver-directed strategic weapon: Helldivers vote on where it deploys and donate resources to activate powerful Tactical Actions that support campaigns on the planet it orbits.

star-of-peace.title: Star of Peace
star-of-peace.description: The Star of Peace is a powerful Super Earth weapon whose plans became a major strategic concern during the Second Galactic War. Automaton forces obtained information connected to the weapon, prompting Super Earth to launch Operation Valid Pretext and prevent the Automatons from developing their own planet-destroying capability.

element-e-711.title: Element E-711
element-e-711.description: Element E-711 is a substance associated with later Super Earth research and technological development during the Second Galactic War. It is distinct from Element 710 and became relevant as Super Earth continued developing new technologies in response to the escalating galactic conflict.

star-of-peace.title: Star of Peace
star-of-peace.description: The Star of Peace is a major weapon system installed on the Democracy Space Station as part of Operation Free Space. Its primary weapon fires a beam of ionized Dark Fluid synthesized using E-711, with enough energy to collapse an entire planet into a conventional black hole. After resources were gathered and construction completed at Pandora Base, Helldivers voted for Penta as its inaugural target. The weapon fired successfully, destroying Penta and leaving behind a stable black hole.

terminid-control-system.title: Terminid Control System
terminid-control-system.description: The Terminid Control System, commonly called the TCS, was a network of massive Termicide-dispensing towers constructed by SEAF engineers to quarantine the Terminid advance. Helldivers activated the system during Operation Valiant Enclosure. The plan ultimately backfired when Terminids developed resistance to Termicide and began reproducing and mutating at dramatically increased rates, contributing to the transformation of Meridia into a Terminid Supercolony.

terminid-control-system-plus.title: Terminid Control System+
terminid-control-system-plus.description: The Terminid Control System+, commonly called TCS+, is a new generation of Terminid containment technology developed by Super Earth in 2186. The system uses networks of towers to dispense Termicide 2.0 on planets bordering the Terminid Gloom front. Construction began as part of Operation Celestial Fence, with the planned network intended to form a defensive barrier against further Terminid expansion.

termicide-2.title: Termicide 2.0
termicide-2.description: Termicide 2.0 is a newer anti-Terminid chemical developed by Super Earth following the disastrous long-term consequences of the original Termicide. Completed in 2186, the formula was designed for deployment through the Terminid Control System+ network along the Gloom front. Super Earth intended the improved chemical and TCS+ towers to prevent further Terminid expansion into Federation territory.

dark-fluid.title: Dark Fluid
dark-fluid.description: Dark Fluid is a highly classified exotic substance originally derived from Illuminate technology captured following the First Galactic War. Super Earth scientists weaponized Dark Fluid during Operation Enduring Peace to destroy the Terminid Supercolony on Meridia, where its deployment ultimately collapsed the planet into a black hole. Super Earth later learned to synthesize Dark Fluid using Element-711 recovered from Hive Worlds, allowing the substance to be used as part of the Star of Peace weapon system.

dark-fluid-vessel.title: Dark Fluid Vessel
dark-fluid-vessel.description: The Dark Fluid Vessel is a specialized backpack container designed to transport highly unstable Dark Fluid. During the operation to destroy the Meridia Supercolony, Helldivers carried these vessels to Tectonic Drills and inserted them into the equipment so Dark Fluid could be injected beneath the planet's surface. The vessel can also function as an unusually powerful jump pack, although repeated use destabilizes its contents and can eventually cause a lethal explosion.

galactic-wide-web.title: Galactic Wide Web
galactic-wide-web.description: The Galactic Wide Web, commonly abbreviated as GWW, is Super Earth's galaxy-spanning communications network. It uses arrays of interlinked quantum devices to transmit information across enormous distances, allowing citizens and military personnel to receive voice communications, text, news, and official information even during deep-space travel and wartime operations. The network also supports Super Earth's Managed Democracy voting system.

voting-algorithm.title: Voting Algorithm
voting-algorithm.description: The Voting Algorithm is the computerized system used to implement Managed Democracy throughout the Federation of Super Earth. Instead of manually selecting a candidate, citizens answer questions at a voting terminal and the algorithm determines which candidate best corresponds to their responses. Voting terminals aboard Super Destroyers allow Helldivers to participate in this system while deployed.

seaf-artillery.title: SEAF Artillery
seaf-artillery.description: SEAF Artillery is a stationary Super Earth artillery platform found on planetary battlefields. Helldivers can reactivate an artillery site by loading five available shells and establishing a connection between the platform and their Super Destroyer. Once operational, the squad gains access to five artillery strikes using the shells that were loaded. Available ammunition includes Explosive, High-Yield Explosive, Mini-Nuke, Smoke, Static Field, and Napalm shells.

seaf-sam-site.title: SEAF SAM Site
seaf-sam-site.description: SEAF SAM Sites are surface-to-air defense installations constructed by Super Earth. Helldivers can reactivate abandoned or captured sites during operations, after which the launcher automatically engages hostile aircraft within approximately 300 meters. The system carries twenty-four missiles before exhausting its ammunition and can target threats including Automaton Dropships and Gunships as well as Illuminate Stingrays, Warp Ships, and Leviathans.

radar-station.title: Radar Station
radar-station.description: Radar Stations are Super Earth installations used to survey planetary mission areas. Helldivers can reactivate a station by raising its radar tower and correctly aligning the dish. Once operational, the station reveals enemy outposts, optional objectives, and Minor Places of Interest across the mission map. Radar Stations are sometimes labeled LiDAR Stations in the field, although this naming has been identified as an unintended inconsistency.

icbm-launch-site.title: ICBM Launch Site
icbm-launch-site.description: ICBM Launch Sites are fortified Super Earth missile installations containing powerful intercontinental ballistic missiles. Dormant launch sites can be reactivated by Helldivers during planetary operations and used to destroy major enemy targets at long range. Depending on the operation, these missiles have been directed against massive Automaton factories, mature Terminid hives, and Illuminate positions.

alcubierre-warp-bubble.title: Modified Alcubierre Warp Bubble
alcubierre-warp-bubble.description: Modified Alcubierre Warp Bubbles were developed by Super Earth scientists as a method of safely penetrating the Illuminate-created Void. Conventional travel into the anomaly had previously been impossible due to its severe spacetime effects. The breakthrough enabled Super Earth ships to enter Void-engulfed space and formed the technological basis for the assault that ultimately reached the Void Source Planet during Operation Void Piercer.

tcs-plus-wall.title: TCS+ Wall
tcs-plus-wall.description: The TCS+ Wall is an interplanetary containment network composed of Terminid Control System+ arrays positioned across strategically selected planets. Each array disperses Termicide 2.0 into its planet's atmosphere to prevent Terminid infestation and expansion. Construction began during Operation Celestial Fence and was extended during Operation Permanent Enclosure, producing a multi-sector defensive cordon intended to contain the Terminid Horde.

democracy-space-station.title: Democracy Space Station
democracy-space-station.description: The Democracy Space Station, commonly abbreviated DSS, is a massive Super Earth-controlled space structure designed to provide strategic support to Helldiver operations. Its destination is determined through Helldiver voting, while donated resources activate powerful Tactical Actions. Plans for the station were recovered from an abandoned Advanced Weapons Lab on X-45, and the DSS was subsequently constructed in orbit of Gaellivare before entering service during the Second Galactic War.

high-efficiency-alcubierre-drive.title: High-Efficiency Alcubierre Drive
high-efficiency-alcubierre-drive.description: The High-Efficiency Alcubierre Drive is an advanced Super Earth faster-than-light propulsion system developed to transport enormous space structures such as the Democracy Space Station without the prohibitive E-710 consumption of conventional drives. Development was assigned to scientists at the Xenoentomology Center on Turing during construction of the DSS, allowing the completed station to redeploy between planets during the Galactic War.

dss-tactical-actions.title: DSS Tactical Actions
dss-tactical-actions.description: DSS Tactical Actions are strategic support capabilities activated through the Democracy Space Station. Helldivers contribute resources to the station to fund these actions, which then provide battlefield or Galactic War benefits to the planet currently orbited by the DSS. The system allows the Helldiver population to collectively determine both the station's destination and which strategic capabilities receive resources.

eagle-storm.title: Eagle Storm
eagle-storm.description: Eagle Storm is a Democracy Space Station Tactical Action that deploys periodic Eagle air support during Helldiver missions on the planet currently supported by the DSS. In addition to providing Eagle strikes during missions, the action can slow enemy progress during planetary Defense Campaigns, allowing the station to influence both individual operations and the wider Galactic War.

orbital-blockade.title: Orbital Blockade
orbital-blockade.description: Orbital Blockade is a Democracy Space Station Tactical Action intended to interfere with enemy movement around the planet currently supported by the DSS. By using the station as a strategic blockade platform, Super Earth can restrict hostile activity at the planetary level and influence the wider Galactic War beyond the effects of individual Helldiver missions.

planetary-bombardment.title: Planetary Bombardment
planetary-bombardment.description: Planetary Bombardment is a Democracy Space Station Tactical Action that uses the station's heavy orbital weaponry to support Helldiver operations on the planet below. When active, the DSS conducts bombardments during missions while also contributing strategic pressure to the Galactic War. The action represents the station functioning as a massive orbital fire-support platform.

planetary-defense-cannon.title: Planetary Defense Cannon
planetary-defense-cannon.description: The Planetary Defense Cannon is an enormous Super Earth defensive weapon designed to engage massive hostile spacecraft from the planetary surface. During operations against the Illuminate, Helldivers can restore and operate these installations to attack Illuminate Overships. Once brought online and properly targeted, the cannon provides the firepower necessary to penetrate the defenses of these enormous enemy vessels.
